module: Console benchmark script (outside the game): it compares the speed of JSON decoding, lpack encoding/decoding (text and binary) and string.buffer on all *.jbeam files in the /vehicles folder. It runs as soon as it is loaded, without exporting any function. Only useful to measure performance, not for a mod.
notes: The script runs entirely on load (require) and prints the times and throughputs in MB/s with print.
It reads the files with FS:findFiles('/vehicles', '*.jbeam', -1, false, false) then readFile; each test is repeated 6 times (local variable reruns).
The throughput displayed for lpack decoding is computed on the packed size (totalPackSize), not on the original JSON size.
